summary: from_yaml_all converts a multi-document YAML string into a variable structure using yaml.safe_load_all; with a single document it behaves like from_yaml.
questions: How do I parse a YAML string with multiple documents separated by ---?
Why does from_yaml fail on multi-document YAML?

answer_card.title: from_yaml_all filter
answer_card.answer_md: Ansible doesn't handle multi-document YAML by default. `{{ s | from_yaml_all }}` parses all documents using PyYAML's `yaml.safe_load_all`. With a single document it's the same as `from_yaml`. Name conflicts between documents are resolved by PyYAML.
